scope: Four previously supported hand/Currier/section/P strata; shared H/F loci. Interior-start right bigrams only. No semantic interpretation.
split: Hash order v62-fixed:<numbered folio>; first floor(n/2) training, remainder test; same H/F allocation; recto/verso/foldouts grouped. Prior analyses exposed these pages: retrospective held-out procedure, not untouched confirmation.
selection: Exact v61 top five training pairs, count>=2, rank excess/sqrt(expected+1), lexical ties. 999 shuffles. No held-out feature selection.
null: v59 unchanged: within-line contiguous readable interiors shuffled; first/last and unknown barriers fixed. Broad position preserved, not exact interior ordinal.
test: 999 permutations, fixed candidate phrase tails, within-panel Bonferroni candidate count and global Bonferroni total frozen tests. Positive excess and global p<=.05. Agreement requires exact phrase selected and passing in both H/F of same stratum; H/F not independent replication.
support: Require >=3 training and >=3 test folios and >=100 readable words in each; otherwise unestimable without resplitting. All failures retained.
